answer: A physical attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to authenticate via optical speckle patterns. During registration, a laser beam reflects off a mirror across a micro-composite of powdered marble and walnut shell grain. An adversary cannot virtualize nodes and must expend capital acquiring discrete physical scattering hardware for each identity. However, surface dust and micro-abrasions alter the scatter pattern over time, triggering false rejections of honest agents.
